note: On the Suncook River, with a no-lifeguard swimming area, a boat ramp, mini golf and hiking trails; the Live Free Waterfront sites sit on the riverbank. Check-in 3-5 pm, none after 8 pm. Day visitors pay $5 a person. Weekly and monthly stays on Premium and Waterfront sites are billed metered electric. Seasonal sites as well as nightly ones. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Campspot capture: nightly RV $45 (Select, 2 sites fit 23 ft) to $75 (Waterfront), +2.9% surcharge; price gate passes at $45 ($46.31 with the surcharge). Not mostly seasonal (~37 of ~66 RV sites sold nightly, estimate). Google 4.7/237. Season May 1 - Oct 11. Riverfront questioned: the Suncook here is ~15-20 m of water, so by size it is creekside. Note rewritten, extra_person written.
flags: Price gate passes: cheapest RV night a 23-ft rig can book is $45 (Live Free Select; only 2 of its 19 sites take 23 ft+; $46.31 with the park's 2.9% surcharge, before Campspot's $3 booking fee), June 2027 Tuesday and Saturday alike. Summer peak $75 (Live Free Waterfront); Standard $49, Premium $57. Not a Good Sam park; no gateway within 40 km. Campspot read 2026-10-14 (closed season since); recheck May.

Long-stay: nightly share ~55% (estimate). Campspot sells 37 RV sites by the night (Select 19, Premium 10, Standard 4, Waterfront 4) plus 8 tent sites. The virtual tour labels about 34 numbered sites, R1-R5, SF1-SF20 and C2-C9 (C/SF rows not on Campspot, presumably seasonal) and T1-T12/WA1-WA3 tent sites, so roughly 37 of ~66 RV sites are nightly. 'interestED IN SEASONAL OR LONG TERM STAY?' and '2026 SEASONAL sites are sold out!' on the rv-rates page; nothing discourages nightly guests; no standing minimum (1-night quotes available). Google 4.7 from 237 reviews; a review says 'Mix of seasonal and day campers'. Keep; not 'mostly seasonal', so the note doesn't use that wording.

Waterfront: SUGGEST riverfront -> creekside (stored value is not --AWH; set by an earlier Claude pass from Campspot's 'Waterfront Site' tags). Esri imagery shows the Suncook at the bend east of the sites (around 43.2327,-71.3585) as about 15-20 m of open water, so by the ~30 m size rule it is a creek. On-water itself still holds: Campspot tags sites 05 (45 ft), 06 (32 ft), R-4 (40 ft) and R-5 (45 ft) 'Waterfront Site' ('This wooded site sits right on the water', sold by the night as Live Free Waterfront at $75), the per-site map draws them at the bank, and the tour puts R1-R5 by the boat ramp. The campground is canopy-blind under pine, so no pad coordinates.
Hookups/sites/facilities/booking unchanged (already sourced to the Campspot read 2026-10-14). The operator site posts no rates (rates live on Campspot).
Extra persons: 2 parents + 2 children included; overnight guests $10 per person (ages 5+), 6 max ('All additional persons shall pay guest fees'). Day guests $5 a person (note).
Phone 603-736-9758 confirmed (operator site, Google). Website unchanged.
No ATVs, mini bikes, mopeds or drones; weekend and transient campers may not bring golf carts (rules page).
